ux.mm4c.daysNote: Days follow the calendar date (race day): practice two days before, qualifying the day before; with two or more races, the first one is the day before.
ux.mm4c.forecastNote: The forecast is as good as your data engineer; it firms up before each session.
ux.mm4c.noStandings: There are no standings for this category.
ux.mm4c.roundResultSub: Income minus expenses of the event
ux.mm4c.balanceNote: The same concepts as the Finance page. "This round" is what was posted from the start of the event to its end (prize money, bonuses, sponsorship, shop, travel, repairs, salaries falling due...); "Year to date" is the season total. Only concepts with money this season are listed.
ux.mm4c.noMoney: No money has moved this season yet.
